{
 "path": "programs/task-f1627406.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform separator column lies between two equal-width panels.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    # The shared panel color is used as the output background; equal aligned
    # cells are highlighted in color 3.
    shared = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    bg = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else bg
             for c in range(sep)] for r in range(h)]
"
}
